As an Intern Bachelors Chemical Eng here at Honeywell, you will gain hands-on experience and exposure to various aspects of chemical engineering within our company. At Honeywell, our people leaders play a critical role in developing and supporting our employees to help them perform at their best and drive change across the company. Conduct research and analysis to stay updated with industry trends and advancements in chemical engineering 
Participate in project planning and execution to ensure successful outcomes 
Ensure compliance with safety regulations and industry standards 
Provide technical support and troubleshooting for chemical engineering projects 
Collaborate with team members to drive innovation and continuous improvement 
YOU MUST HAVE
Enrollment in a Chemical Engineering program 
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

Pursuing an advanced degree in Chemical Engineering 
Experience with chemical engineering principles and practices 
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

https://careers.honeywell.com/en/sites/H.desc:
YOU MUST HAVE 
Pursuing Chartered Accountancy (CA) – eligible for Industrial Training as per ICAI guidelines 
Eagerness to learn and take on new challenges. 
Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 
 Key Responsibilities 
Post monthly journal entries accurately and on time 
Upload Trial Balance into the Hyperion consolidation tool for group reporting. 
Prepare monthly schedules required for consolidation and reporting. 
Assist the Entity Controller in closing monthly books of accounts. 
Support statutory audit requirements, including preparation of audit schedules and responding to auditor queries. 
Assist with data analysis and reporting. 
Conduct research and gather information for various projects. 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve goals. 
Participate in team meetings and contribute ideas and suggestions. 
WE VALUE 
Required experience in a similar field should be enough. 
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. 
Proficiency in MS Excel and other financial systems 
 Stipend - 40 K Monthly 
 Duration - 9 - 12 Months 
 Location - Pune 
 Work from Office (Mon-Fri) 
 looking for an immediate joiner 
 Eligibility Criteria: Candidates currently pursuing CA are eligible. Candidates pursuing any other academic degree or professional course are not eligible.
